articles.title: Wireless Transceiver Rivals Fiber-Optic Speed
articles.description: To create the transceiver, researchers in UC Irvine’s Samueli School of Engineering devised a unique architecture that blends digital and analog processing. The result is a silicon chip system, comprising both a transmitter and a receiver, that’s capable of processing digital signals much faster.

articles.title: Same Sky Launches New Microphone Development Kits
articles.description: Same Sky and its Audio Group announced the introduction of microphone development kits. Each kit consists of four independent microphone evaluation circuits with plated-through-hole I/O terminals for multiple testing options. The four detachable evaluation circuits each offer a different Same Sky microphone configuration, including analog and digital MEMS microphones as well as unidirectional, omnidirectional, and noise-canceling electret condenser microphones.
